docs.purpose: Records that a user opened, saved or un-saved a specific job or builder lead. The first time a free-trial user views a given permit it counts against their limited monthly allowance of lead views. It also returns how many other tradespeople are currently interested in the same lead.
docs.data_story: It reads 3 tables — `lead_views`, `user_profiles` and `entitlements` and writes `lead_view_events`, `user_profiles` and `lead_views`. Its response is an explicit pick-by-name projection of 1 field, so a column added to a table upstream does not leak into the client by accident. It is called from 1 place: `src/features/leads/api/useLeadView.ts`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `MUTATION`. It declares `database.writes[]` with a `write_discipline` per target (the Spec 122 vocabulary verbatim), its idempotency posture, its optimistic contract and its rollback. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.

notes: The file's SPEC LINK cites docs/specs/03-mobile/71_lead_feed_discovery_interface.md, which does not exist — the real file is the archived path recorded here (verified by find). The trial-view counter (only when action='view', lead_type='permit', subscription_status='trial') uses an atomic CTE — INSERT INTO lead_view_events ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING 1, then UPDATE user_profiles ... WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins) — avoiding a double increment on a race between two concurrent views of the same permit. The main upsert/count logic is delegated to src/features/leads/lib/record-lead-view.ts. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: SPEC 126 §1 CALLER CLAIM — VERIFIED TRUE (no production caller). I grepped `src/**` and `mobile/**` for the literal `/api/leads/view` and for `leads/view`. In src/ the only fetch call site is src/features/leads/api/useLeadView.ts:25 (`fetch('/api/leads/view', {method:'POST', ...})`). I then grepped the whole repo for `useLeadView`: the ONLY importer is src/tests/useLeadView.logic.test.tsx:12. No component, page, or other hook imports it (src/features/leads/api/query-client.ts:10 mentions it in a comment only — a comment, not evidence of a call). In mobile/ there is NO reference at all: `grep -o 'api/leads/[a-z-]*' mobile/src mobile/app` returns only feed, save, flight-board, detail, search — never `view` (mobile/src/hooks/useSaveLead.ts:27, useRemoveFromBoard.ts:21-22, SearchPermitsSheet.tsx:46-47 all hit /api/leads/save instead). VERDICT: the route is reachable only from tests; src/features/leads/api/useLeadView.ts is itself dead outside tests. COUNTER COLUMNS: `user_profiles.lead_views_count`, incremented by +1 at src/app/api/leads/view/route.ts:110 (UPDATE at :109, WHERE user_id = $1 at :111), gated on `EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)` at :112 where `ins` is the lead_view_events INSERT CTE at :103-108. The whole block is additionally gated on action==='view' AND lead_type==='permit' AND ctx.subscription_status==='trial' (route.ts:101). So the estate's only usage meter is: (a) behind a dead caller, and (b) behind a trial-only + permit-only + view-action-only triple gate. CENSUS AGREEMENT: census_reads (lead_views, user_profiles, entitlements) and census_writes (lead_view_events, user_profiles, lead_views) both match what I read. Aliases resolved: the `ins` in `EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)` (route.ts:112) is the CTE at route.ts:103, NOT a table — the real table is lead_view_events (route.ts:104). | Idempotency: Guarded, and the guard is the interesting part. (1) The trial counter is replay-safe by construction: `INSERT INTO lead_view_events ... ON CONFLICT (user_id, permit_num, revision_num) DO NOTHING RETURNING 1` (src/app/api/leads/view/route.ts:104-107) feeds a CTE, and the `UPDATE user_profiles SET lead_views_count = lead_views_count + 1` only fires `AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ins)` (route.ts:112) — so a second POST for the same (user, permit, revision) inserts nothing and increments nothing, forever. (2) The lead_views write is an UPSERT on (user_id, lead_key, trade_slug): the view branch sets only `viewed_at = NOW()` (src/features/leads/lib/record-lead-view.ts:152-153), the save branch forces saved/saved_at (record-lead-view.ts:173-175). No IS DISTINCT FROM guard — timestamps move on every replay; the row state does not. | Caching: none observed — no revalidate/dynamic/Cache-Control/unstable_cache in src/app/api/leads/view/route.ts:1-152 | Rate bucket: leads-view:<uid> (src/app/api/leads/view/route.ts:85) | Entitlement posture: NOT an access gate. `ctx.subscription_status` is sourced from the entitlements LEFT JOIN (src/lib/auth/get-user-context.ts:99, join text src/lib/entitlements/index.ts:68) and is read only at src/app/api/leads/view/route.ts:101 to decide whether the TRIAL VIEW COUNTER fires. A non-trial user is served identically minus the counter. | Other guards / classification: Trade-membership authorization at src/app/api/leads/view/route.ts:78 — the body trade_slug must be a member of ctx.trade_slugs
